function.name: desktop_project
function.description: Create or switch desktop Projects (named workspaces). create: one and switch this chat into it — pass path to anchor it to a repo/folder (the chat's workspace moves there, the sidebar follows). switch: move this chat into an existing project by name/slug/id — the intentional way to move the session, not `cd`. list: all projects + which is active.

name.description: create: human name. switch: name, slug, or id.
